notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
-p- scans all 65535 ports. --stats-every=5s prints progress updates automatically every 5 seconds (vs pressing spacebar manually). -v reports open ports to terminal as discovered rather than only at completion.

=== WORKFLOW ===
Two-phase approach: quick top-port scan first → -p- full scan in background while analyzing initial results → once -p- completes, target confirmed open ports with -sV.

=== WHY FULL SCAN ===
Services on non-standard ports (web apps on 8080/8443, SSH on 2222, databases on high ports) are missed by default top-1000-ports scan. Full port scan is mandatory for thorough enumeration.
